Who We Are 

 General Catalyst is a global investment and transformation company that partners with the world’s most ambitious entrepreneurs to drive resilience and applied AI. We support founders with a long-term view who challenge the status quo, partnering with them from seed to growth stage and beyond.

 With offices in the U.S., Europe, and India, we have supported the growth of 800+ businesses, including Airbnb, Anduril, Anthropic, Applied Intuition, Commure, Glean, Gusto, Helsing, Hubspot, Kayak, Livongo, Mistral, Ramp, Samsara, Snap, Stripe, Sword, and Zepto.

 GC Wealth serves as an independent wealth and asset management business serving high net worth individuals, family offices, foundations and not for profit organizations.

 About The Role 

 We are seeking a Client Service Associate to join our wealth management organization. 

 The Client Service Associate (CSA) is a key member of the GC Wealth team, supporting the delivery of high-quality service and efficient execution of client needs. This role partners closely with Relationship Managers and Analysts to provide day-to-day support across client accounts and operations. This professional oversees complex client relationships, and serves as a trusted resource for both clients and internal teams. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented and client-focused.

 Key Responsibilities 

• Support client service efforts by responding to inquiries and assisting with relationship management for high-net-worth clients

• Assist with client onboarding, including account openings, KYC documentation, and entity setup (e.g., trusts, LLCs)

• Process cash movements, wires, journals, and securities transfers accurately and in line with firm policies

• Handle account maintenance requests (e.g., beneficiary updates, address changes, standing instructions)

• Monitor accounts for required actions (e.g., RMDs, KYC updates) and escalate as needed

• Support alternative investment activity, including subscriptions, capital calls, and redemptions

• Track and follow up on outstanding items across custodians, banks, and internal teams

• Maintain accurate records and ensure proper documentation for reporting and compliance

• Deliver a high-quality client experience and escalate complex issues appropriately

• Monitor and follow through on outstanding items across custodians, banks, and internal departments.

• Maintain accurate records for cost basis, tax documents, and customized reporting requirements.

• Maintain audit-ready documentation and support internal/external reviews.

• Anticipate client needs and deliver a white-glove, highly responsive service experience.

 Qualifications 

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or related field.

• 1 to 3 years of experience as a Client Service Associate or similar role within a wealth management or investment advisory firm.

• In-depth knowledge of custodial platforms, account administration, and financial operations.

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver exceptional service.

• Excellent attention to detail, communication, and problem-solving skills.

 Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience with wealth management technology platforms and CRM systems.

   At General Catalyst, we believe the best ideas and the boldest outcomes come from people who bring different perspectives to the table. We know that outlier outcomes require us to think differently than everyone else. That’s why we’re committed to building teams that reflect a wide range of backgrounds, experiences and ways of thinking. Diverse perspectives are essential to our mission of responsible innovation and creating inclusive prosperity.

Position Summary:    

 Cerity Partners Ventures (CPV) is hiring Investment Associates for our Built World team. Founded as Touchdown Ventures in 2014, CPV pioneered Venture Capital-as-a-Service (VCaaS) for corporations, working with leading brands like Kellogg, T-Mobile, BEHR, and more. With a team of 50+ investment professionals in Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, New York, Philadelphia, and San Francisco, CPV manages more than 20 corporate venture capital funds. 
 As an Investment Associate, you will work on a dedicated fund team focused on AI, insurance technology, home services, construction technology, building products, and more as part of our larger Built World sector practice. Investment Associates source venture capital investment opportunities and help impact the innovation strategies at some of the world’s most successful corporations. The Associate role is an exciting and entrepreneurial opportunity to join a growing firm, providing potential for growth and advancement. We are building something special and are seeking candidates who share our vision and excitement. 
 This position will be based with our team in San Francisco or New York City.
 Primary Responsibilities   
 • Identify potential start-up investments and source relationships with the company founders 

 • Meet with entrepreneurs and evaluate their business plans and pitches 

 • Track and report on deal flow generated by our team 

 • Research industry sectors, trends, and market dynamics 

 • Assist with due diligence 

 Required Qualifications:   
 • Bachelor’s degree 

 • 1-3 years of relevant work experience  

 Skills and Competencies:   
 • Detail-oriented and self starter who enjoys working in a collegial workplace  

 • Critical thinking skills, including superior research and analytical ability 

 • Positive and flexible attitude  

 • Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and attention to detail 

 • Excellent writing, presentation and verbal communication skills 

 • Ability to build relationships with entrepreneurs, investors, and other stakeholders 

 • Enthusiasm for venture capital, start-ups and entrepreneurship 

 • Willingness to work in a start-up culture 

 Compensation Range:  
 $100,000-115,000
